Maya (CS): Seahawk dedicated cutover checklist: quota, autoscale, and a 20m load test to clear finance hold. Can we land the plan today?
Derek (Infra): What steady qps + burst profile?
Ola (PM): Steady 180 qps, bursts to 700 qps for up to 12m. p95 target <=240ms in eu-west. They care about cache warm-up.
Evan (Oncall): I can run the runbook Tue 2026-06-08 09:00-10:00 UTC. Which pool?
Derek (Infra): Use ded-seahawk-g7. Autoscale draft: min=2, max=22, scale_up at 62% GPU util or 170 qps, scale_down after 6m idle. Will add thermal guard.
Maya (CS): Actions: 1) Derek push autoscale policy PR, 2) Evan execute load test & post logs, 3) Ola validate test dataset & traffic mix, 4) I'll assemble perf note for finance.
res-bot: reservation confirmed: ded-seahawk-g7 @2026-06-08 09:00-10:00 UTC by Evan. ID: RSV-9017.
Derek (Infra): Smoke command:
`k6 run tests/seahawk_burst.js --vus 700 --duration 12m --out json=burst.json`
Also run `scripts/warm_kv.sh --model seahawk-v1 --concurrency 60` before test.
Ola (PM): I'll upload dataset to /shared/seahawk/testset-2026 and include 8% tool-calls, 3% rerank.
Evan (Oncall): I'll do a staging dry-run at 50% tomorrow and post logs here. If we breach thermal threshold (82C) we'll throttle bursts and notify #eng-oncall.
Maya (CS): Great. If perf passes I'll send the one-page report to finance and schedule renewal touchpoint. Ping any blockers here.
